Root.value / defaultValue.semantic: this is the INPUT value (free-form text allowed); there is no selection value. Omitted/renamed equivalents: selectionMode, selectedValue, itemToStringValue, isItemEqualToValue, fillInputOnItemPress.

Root.mode.semantic: 'list' filters items without touching the input; 'both' filters and inline-completes the input from the active item; 'inline' keeps items static but inline-completes; 'none' keeps items static and never changes the input.

Root.autoHighlight.semantic: true highlights the first match after typing; 'always' always highlights the first item (e.g. list rendered inside a dialog).

Root.keepHighlight.semantic: keeps the highlight when the pointer leaves the list.

Root.submitOnItemClick.semantic: clicking an item (pointer or Enter) submits the owning form — for single-field search forms.

Root.items.semantic: flat or grouped items; nullish entries unsupported.

Root.grid / inline / virtualized / modal.semantic: grid rows via <Row>; `inline` renders the list without the popup (pass `open` unconditionally); `virtualized` declares external virtualization.

Root.name / form / inputRef / id.semantic: hidden input naming (inputRef is typed against the hidden input element).

Item.value / index / disabled / onClick.semantic: value carries the item object so itemToStringValue receives it; onClick fires on pointer click and Enter.

Empty / Status / Clear / Separator / Gro.semantic: Empty requires `items`; Status is a polite live region and must remain mounted.

useFilter / useFilteredItems.semantic: external filtering helpers (the autocomplete entry re-exports the core filter, not the combobox variant).

dataAttributes: Item: data-highlighted, data-disabled (note: NO data-selected — autocomplete has no selection state)
Trigger: data-popup-open, data-pressed, data-disabled, data-readonly, data-popup-side, data-required, data-valid, data-invalid, data-touched, data-dirty, data-filled, data-focused, data-list-empty
InputGroup: data-popup-open, data-pressed, data-disabled, data-readonly, data-popup-side, data-valid, data-invalid, data-touched, data-dirty, data-filled, data-focused, data-list-empty

Input/List/Popup/Positioner/Arrow/Backdrop: shared with Combobox (data-popup-open/data-pressed/data-* field flags on Input; data-open/data-closed/data-starting-style/data-ending-style/data-side/data-align/data-anchor-hidden on Popup; data-empty on Popup/Positioner/List)
Root / Value / Label / Group / GroupLabel / Separator / Row / Empty / Status: none
renderProp: Identical shared `render` prop contract (ReactElement | (props, state) => ReactElement) on every part; useRender for custom components; mergeProps/mergePropsN for prop merging (rightmost wins, handlers merged right-to-left, className concatenated, style merged, ref not merged).
controlled: `value`/`defaultValue` (input text) + `onValueChange(value, eventDetails)`; `open`/`defaultOpen` + `onOpenChange` and `onOpenChangeComplete`. `actionsRef` -> { unmount }. There is no selected-value control at all (the component intentionally has no selection state).
formIntegration: Autocomplete reuses Combobox's AriaCombobox root (verified: autocomplete/root/AutocompleteRoot.mjs imports ../../combobox/root/AriaCombobox.mjs and spreads props into it), so the hidden `<input type=hidden form name value>` submission path and Field.Root data-* flags are the same as Combobox. `submitOnItemClick` opts into submitting the owning form when an item is clicked (pointer or Enter) — default is no submit.
keyboard: ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the highlight (input included in the loop, `loopFocus` default true); Home/End move the text caret inside the input; Escape closes/clears through the shared combobox handlers; Enter activates the highlighted item and does not submit unless `submitOnItemClick` is set; typed characters filter items (Intl.Collator) rather than triggering typeahead. In `mode='inline'|'both'` navigating with arrow keys temporarily rewrites the input value from the active item (docs' 'Inline autocomplete'). No PageUp/PageDown handling in 1.8.0.
notableDifferences: React Aria has no dedicated free-form autocomplete primitive: Autocomplete is 'Combobox without selection' here — its `value` is the input text, there is no selected key/value, and no data-selected on items.
`mode` ('list'|'both'|'inline'|'none') is unique to Base UI and controls both filtering and inline completion; React Aria expresses this only through inputValue control.
`openOnInputClick` defaults to false (Combobox defaults true) — a migration that relied on click-to-open must set it.
Enter does not submit the form by default; use `submitOnItemClick` for search-style single-field forms.

Autocomplete deliberately omits Combobox's selection-only props (selectionMode/selectedValue/isItemEqualToValue/itemToStringValue/fillInputOnItemPress) and omits the Chips/Chip/ChipRemove/createItems exports.
Same Portal > Positioner > Popup composition and the same data-* state vocabulary as Combobox.
